_comment: Authoritative publish times, keyed by MEPS language code, in UTC (ISO-8601).
These win over the media API's firstPublished, which records when a file
entered the CDN and can run earlier than public availability -- English
reports 2026-09-18T11:39:09Z but was actually published at 14:00Z.
Add an entry as a confirmed time becomes known; remove one to fall back
